1	# Task 04: 도메인 뷰 & slug 유틸
2	
3	## 목적
4	Prisma 엔티티를 RealWorld 응답 JSON으로 변환하는 순수 함수(`profileView`, `articleView`, `commentView`)와 제목→유일 slug 생성기(`makeSlug`)를 구현한다. DB 접근이 없는 순수 로직이므로 T03과 병렬로 작업 가능하다.
5	
6	## 선행 태스크
7	- **T02**: Prisma 모델 필드 형태(아래 입력 타입은 Prisma 반환 형태와 호환).
8	- (T01의 tsconfig/테스트 하네스 사용)
9	
10	## 구현 범위 / 대상 파일
11	- Create: `src/lib/views.ts`, `src/lib/slug.ts`
12	- Create: `tests/views.test.ts`, `tests/slug.test.ts`
13	
14	## 이 태스크가 확립하는 인터페이스 (후행 태스크가 의존)
15	```ts
16	// src/lib/slug.ts
17	export function makeSlug(title: string): string
18	
19	// src/lib/views.ts
20	type ProfileJSON = { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null; following: boolean }
21	type ArticleJSON = { slug: string; title: string; description: string; body?: string; tagList: string[]; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string; favorited: boolean; favoritesCount: number; author: ProfileJSON }
22	type CommentJSON = { id: number; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string; body: string; author: ProfileJSON }
23	
24	export function profileView(user: { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null }, following: boolean): { profile: ProfileJSON }
25	export function articleView(article: { slug: string; title: string; description: string; body: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date; author: { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null }; tags: { name: string }[] }, flags: { favorited: boolean; favoritesCount: number; following: boolean; includeBody?: boolean }): { article: ArticleJSON }
26	export function commentView(comment: { id: number; body: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date; author: { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null } }, following: boolean): { comment: CommentJSON }
27	```
28	
29	## 구현
30	
31	### Step 1: `src/lib/slug.ts`
32	```ts
33	import slugify from 'slugify'
34	import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
35	
36	export function makeSlug(title: string): string {
37	  const base = slugify(title, { lower: true, strict: true }) || 'article'
38	  const suffix = randomBytes(3).toString('hex') // 6자리 hex → 유일성 보장
39	  return `${base}-${suffix}`
40	}
41	```
42	
43	### Step 2: `src/lib/views.ts`
44	```ts
45	type ProfileJSON = { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null; following: boolean }
46	type ArticleJSON = {
47	  slug: string; title: string; description: string; body?: string
48	  tagList: string[]; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string
49	  favorited: boolean; favoritesCount: number; author: ProfileJSON
50	}
51	type CommentJSON = { id: number; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string; body: string; author: ProfileJSON }
52	
53	type UserLike = { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null }
54	
55	export function profileView(user: UserLike, following: boolean): { profile: ProfileJSON } {
56	  return { profile: { username: user.username, bio: user.bio, image: user.image, following } }
57	}
58	
59	export function articleView(
60	  article: {
61	    slug: string; title: string; description: string; body: string
62	    createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date
63	    author: UserLike; tags: { name: string }[]
64	  },
65	  flags: { favorited: boolean; favoritesCount: number; following: boolean; includeBody?: boolean },
66	): { article: ArticleJSON } {
67	  const out: ArticleJSON = {
68	    slug: article.slug,
69	    title: article.title,
70	    description: article.description,
71	    tagList: article.tags.map((t) => t.name).sort(),
72	    createdAt: article.createdAt.toISOString(),
73	    updatedAt: article.updatedAt.toISOString(),
74	    favorited: flags.favorited,
75	    favoritesCount: flags.favoritesCount,
76	    author: profileView(article.author, flags.following).profile,
77	  }
78	  if (flags.includeBody !== false) out.body = article.body
79	  return { article: out }
80	}
81	
82	export function commentView(
83	  comment: { id: number; body: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date; author: UserLike },
84	  following: boolean,
85	): { comment: CommentJSON } {
86	  return {
87	    comment: {
88	      id: comment.id,
89	      createdAt: comment.createdAt.toISOString(),
90	      updatedAt: comment.updatedAt.toISOString(),
91	      body: comment.body,
92	      author: profileView(comment.author, following).profile,
93	    },
94	  }
95	}
96	```
97	> **주의:** 목록/피드(`includeBody: false`)에서는 `body`가 생략된다. 단일 article 조회/생성/수정에서는 기본값(`includeBody` 미지정 → 포함).
98	
99	### Step 3: 실패 테스트 — `tests/slug.test.ts`
100	```ts
101	import { expect, test } from 'vitest'
102	import { makeSlug } from '../src/lib/slug.js'
103	
104	test('makeSlug produces lowercase kebab with unique suffix', () => {
105	  const a = makeSlug('How to train your Dragon')
106	  expect(a).toMatch(/^how-to-train-your-dragon-[0-9a-f]{6}$/)
107	  const b = makeSlug('How to train your Dragon')
108	  expect(a).not.toBe(b) // 유일성
109	})
110	
111	test('makeSlug handles empty/symbol titles', () => {
112	  expect(makeSlug('!!!')).toMatch(/^article-[0-9a-f]{6}$/)
113	})
114	```
115	
116	### Step 4: 실패 테스트 — `tests/views.test.ts`
117	```ts
118	import { expect, test } from 'vitest'
119	import { profileView, articleView, commentView } from '../src/lib/views.js'
120	
121	const author = { username: 'jake', bio: 'b', image: null }
122	const now = new Date('2016-02-18T03:22:56.637Z')
123	
124	test('profileView shape', () => {
125	  expect(profileView(author, true)).toEqual({
126	    profile: { username: 'jake', bio: 'b', image: null, following: true },
127	  })
128	})
129	
130	test('articleView includes body by default, ISO dates, sorted tags', () => {
131	  const { article } = articleView(
132	    { slug: 's', title: 't', description: 'd', body: 'B', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, author, tags: [{ name: 'z' }, { name: 'a' }] },
133	    { favorited: true, favoritesCount: 3, following: false },
134	  )
135	  expect(article.body).toBe('B')
136	  expect(article.tagList).toEqual(['a', 'z'])
137	  expect(article.createdAt).toBe('2016-02-18T03:22:56.637Z')
138	  expect(article.favoritesCount).toBe(3)
139	  expect(article.author.following).toBe(false)
140	})
141	
142	test('articleView omits body when includeBody false', () => {
143	  const { article } = articleView(
144	    { slug: 's', title: 't', description: 'd', body: 'B', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, author, tags: [] },
145	    { favorited: false, favoritesCount: 0, following: false, includeBody: false },
146	  )
147	  expect('body' in article).toBe(false)
148	})
149	
150	test('commentView shape', () => {
151	  const { comment } = commentView({ id: 1, body: 'hi', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, author }, false)
152	  expect(comment).toEqual({
153	    id: 1, createdAt: '2016-02-18T03:22:56.637Z', updatedAt: '2016-02-18T03:22:56.637Z',
154	    body: 'hi', author: { username: 'jake', bio: 'b', image: null, following: false },
155	  })
156	})
157	```
158	
159	### Step 5: 테스트 실행
160	```bash
161	npm test -- slug views
162	```
163	기대: 모두 통과.
164	
165	### Step 6: 커밋
166	```bash
167	git add -A && git commit -m "feat: add view serializers and slug generator"
168	```
169	
170	## 완료 기준
171	- `makeSlug`가 소문자 kebab + 6자리 hex 접미어를 생성하며 호출마다 유일하다.
172	- `profileView`/`articleView`/`commentView`가 정본 계약(`plan.md`)의 JSON 형태를 정확히 반환한다.
173	- `articleView`가 `includeBody: false`일 때 `body`를 생략한다.
174	- 날짜가 ISO 8601 문자열이고 `tagList`가 정렬된다.
175	
176	## 완료 기록
177	_(실행 세션이 채움)_
